sensor_joint_wrap_screen.result: Conservative lap/tape height exceeds .8; centered 1.1x3x1.0 joint touches lower/separator, 1.1 high intersects lower. No adopted revision.

roomier_joint_trial.finding: 1.1x2.8x1.1 joint budget with .1 nominal gaps is statically clear but leaves sampled lower material only .15 mm. Supporting geometry must be redesigned.

open_joint_pocket_trial.finding: Previous .15 mm interval was an upper residual roof, not floor. Sampled floor thickness minimum .9636 mm. Removed residual roof, retained one valid lower solid and zero static overlap with separator/board/battery. Solid-common contact result is insufficient to establish support.
open_joint_pocket_trial.updated_finding: Downward .001 mm separator displacement intersects lower in several distributed regions, proxy area 8.484 mm2; upward .01 has zero overlap. Both parts sliced; local nominal bead mating overlap zero. No strength, full printed fit or manufacturing approval.

full_printed_mating_screen.finding: Full lower/separator XY comparison finds four overlapping layer pairs at front/rear/central supports, not covered by prior local joint ROI. Need verify slicer placement/layer interpretation before geometry changes.
full_printed_mating_screen.updated_finding: First-layer outer-wall centerlines themselves lie above CAD intervals beginning -2.22, while nominal first-layer material starts -2.42. This is not solely lateral bead expansion. Fine .08/.08 mm slicing still overlaps supports; do not adopt either process as fit-qualified.
full_printed_mating_screen.mesh_finding: At five support/interference probes, STEP, binary STL and transformed 3MF triangles agree at Z -2.22/-1.92. No export mismatch at tested positions. Raw G-code uses Z .14 for first-layer paths. Remaining issue is slicing behavior or nominal toolpath interpretation, not demonstrated CAD export corruption.

flipped_separator_print_trial.finding: X180 export rotation with inverse XY/Z layer transform removes full lower/separator nominal bead overlap. Four support regions retain .06 mm nominal vertical gap at unchanged CAD placement. Seating, other components, support removal and printed strength unverified.

printed_joint_envelope_screen.finding: 1.1x2.8x1.1 joint budgets clear both nominal printed parts; minimum lateral gap across shared Z .06289 mm. This is not tolerance-qualified clearance.

sensor_lead_insulation_screen.finding: Previously unmodeled Y22..23.2 exposed lead segment with provisional .08 mm wrap is nominally clear, but lower gap only .02 mm. Joint budget clearance does not cover this segment. Need transition and manufacturing allowance.

lead_wrap_clearance_revision.finding: CAD lead-wrap gap increased .02 to .15 mm, same case bounding box, one solid. Support displacement proxy unchanged. Resliced lower has no full nominal overlap with flipped separator; .06 mm support gaps remain.

sensor_insulation_transition_trial.finding: Lead wrap and larger joint envelopes joined over local Y23..23.4; each one valid solid, static overlap zero. Minimum lower gap .09894 mm, conductor-envelope separation .7 mm. Actual wrapping continuity and retention unqualified.
